purpose: Replace loading and login background images to fit the actual modern-city swordsman game

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished full-screen loading background for an existing Unity urban-fantasy action MMORPG. Create ONE polished cinematic landscape illustration, 16:9 horizontal composition, target 1920x1080. The actual game world is a modern city with broad asphalt avenues, yellow road markings, sidewalks, planted trees, glass-and-concrete office towers, brick buildings, streetlights and an elevated bridge; its hero is a stylized white-haired swordsman in black and burgundy. Make the background feel mighty, imposing and suited to THAT modern urban-fantasy world. Scene: a sweeping low cinematic view down an empty monumental city avenue toward a dramatic bridge and dense modern skyline at night after rain. In the upper LEFT half, an enormous majestic spectral dragon, obsidian scales edged with restrained pale cyan light, coils through storm clouds above skyscrapers, conveying guardian-like power rather than a horror monster. A narrow break of warm dawn light at the distant horizon, subtle gold streetlights and damp reflections, rich charcoal navy, muted steel cyan and small warm amber accents. Semi-realistic stylized 3D game key-art, clean readable forms and detailed architecture, realistic scale, deep atmospheric perspective, beautiful controlled lighting. Keep the central lower 40 percent calm and dark enough for a real progress bar/status overlay; important dragon detail stays above the horizon. The city is intact and grand, no armies, no human figures, no cars filling foreground. No icy fantasy castle, no snow, no traditional pagodas, no medieval village, no floating UI panels. Edge-to-edge original environment artwork only, NO TEXT, NO LOGO, NO WATERMARK, no frame, no grid. Do not draw a loading bar or interface. Single complete image, not a collage.

Scene: grand modern riverside district and immense contemporary stone/concrete bridge seen from a broad elevated pedestrian plaza, modern skyline rising on the LEFT, dramatic dawn breaking between storm clouds, the silhouette of a huge elegant spectral dragon soaring very high above and behind the LEFT-side buildings. Foreground dark paving, carefully placed trees and amber streetlights, sweeping perspective and layered atmospheric depth; a faint pale cyan magical glow in cloud edges, integrated tastefully, not a neon cyberpunk world. Composition is practical for a real login screen: architectural/dragon focal detail mainly in LEFT 50 percent, the RIGHT 35 percent is a quieter mid-dark atmospheric skyline/plaza with low visual contrast so actual input fields remain legible. No human characters because game UI supplies its own characters. No snow, no ice castle, no medieval fortress, no traditional Chinese palace, no giant glowing lettering. Edge-to-edge original background art only. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO LOGO, NO WATERMARK, no border, no grid, no interface, no drawn buttons or panels. One complete scene, not a split-screen or collage.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-screen character selection background for a Unity urban-fantasy MMORPG. ONE finished 16:9 landscape illustration, target 1920x1080. Cohesive with our blue-grey modern city, monumental bridges, spectral dragons and restrained antique-gold / teal interface. Make a grand modern city overlook at blue hour before dawn, wide slate terrace, brushed metal railings, distant modern glass-and-stone skyline and river bridges, clouded sky, sparse amber streetlights. On the LEFT-CENTER of the foreground (x38%, y80%) a FLAT circular teal-and-gold floor inlay marks where Unity will render a real full-body white-haired swordsman OR young traveler. Keep x20-56%, y18-80% open with simple medium-dark blue mist so character silhouettes read clearly, NO painted character. The RIGHT third is intentionally dark, calm and low contrast for a real character information panel added later; no bright sunset behind it. Frame only far outer edges with monumental modern architectural elements and sparse trees, no obstructions at the central standing area. One restrained spectral dragon shape dissolves into the distant UPPER LEFT cloud bank, not over the character's face. Premium semi-realistic stylized 3D fantasy game key-art, majestic scale, readable soft atmosphere, tasteful cool blue and muted gold palette. Perspective supports a standing hero on the left-center stage. Lower edge calm for nickname field and creation controls. No humans, no statues of people, no character silhouettes, no medieval palace, no pink candy colors, no snow, no weapon embedded in floor, no oversized portal. NO TEXT, NO LOGO, NO WATERMARK, no UI, no labels, no buttons, no interface frame, no collage. Background environment only.
